IMAGEKIT_PUBLIC_KEY.description: ImageKit says it is not meant to be a secret and may be published in client-side JavaScript or a mobile app. The prefix is documented. The variable name is convention.

IMAGEKIT_PRIVATE_KEY.description: ImageKit says to keep it confidential and only on your servers, and its browser SDK throws if you pass one. A new pair carries the same permissions and works at once; you choose when the old expires. The prefix is documented.

IMAGEKIT_URL_ENDPOINT.description: Where images are served from. ImageKit does not classify it, but it appears in every delivery URL a visitor loads. The name is convention.
